title: Trust Fall Tim & The Catchers at Community Center
body:
Trust Fall Tim & The Catchers are performing at the Community Center in Your City on Your Birthday at 7:00 PM. Tickets were $20 but the show is sold out.

Why you can't go: It's on your birthday and you already have plans you can't cancel.
summary: Trust Fall Tim & The Catchers on your birthday. Sold out. In your city. Can't go.
